answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a measured tone, citations in parentheses register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the basalt of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the terrace re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. By the falcon of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
